statistical_analysis_and_power_plan.linear_mixed_effects_model_specification: Y_{ijkd} = x_i^T * beta + u_clone(g(i),j) + b_batch(k) + v_donor(d) + epsilon_{ijkd}, where x_i in R^23 is the coded design row [1, X1..X6, 15 2FIs, stage_block_B], u_clone(g(i),j) ~ N(0, sigma_clone^2) is the random intercept for independently edited hPSC clone j of genotype g(i) (preventing clonal pseudo-replication), b_batch(k) ~ N(0, sigma_batch^2) is the differentiation batch random effect, v_donor(d) ~ N(0, sigma_donor^2) is the PBMC/NK/macrophage donor random effect, and epsilon_{ijkd} ~ N(0, sigma_eps^2) is the residual assay error.
statistical_analysis_and_power_plan.effective_run_level_variance_formula: Defining sigma_eps = 7.0 percentage points (pp) as the donor-averaged clone-by-batch cell residual (averaged across n_donors = 3 immune donors after donor-block centering), averaging over n_clones = 3 clones and n_batches = 2 differentiation batches per run yields effective run-mean variance sigma_run^2 = sigma_clone^2 / n_clones + sigma_eps^2 / (n_clones * n_batches) = 8.0^2 / 3 + 7.0^2 / 6 = 177/6 = 29.50 pp^2 -> sigma_run = 5.43 pp (whereas if 7.0 pp represents the single-donor well residual epsilon_{ijkd}, averaging across n_donors = 3 donors gives sigma_run,3donors = sqrt(8.0^2 / 3 + 7.0^2 / (3 * 2 * 3)) = sqrt(433/18) = 4.90 pp; and single-clone pseudo-replication n_clones = 1 would inflate sigma_run to sqrt(8.0^2 + 7.0^2/2) = 9.41 pp). Both Mode 1 (108 independent run-nested clone differentiations, Cov(Y_bar) = sigma_run^2 * I_36) and Mode 2 (75 shared-genotype clones across 25 distinct genotypes, Cov(Y_bar) = (sigma_clone^2 / n_clones) * Z Z^T + (sigma_eps^2 / (n_clones * n_batches)) * I_36 with exact GLS and OLS sandwich SEs) are reported below.

constant_isogenic_backbone.dosing_unit: Two-Step Lineage Purification & Tri-Hormonal Re-Aggregation Workflow: Step 1 (Live-Cell Surface Sorting): Stage 7 SC-islet cultures (after Stage 7 week 0 [S7w0] Aurora kinase inhibitor ZM447439 pulse to suppress off-target enterochromaffin proliferation; Balboa et al. 2022 PMID:35241836) are dissociated and purified without fixation/permeabilization via live-cell surface MACS/FACS into beta-like cells (CD49a+/ITGA1+ live-cell enrichment per Veres et al. 2019 Nature PMID:31068696, which achieves <=80% beta-cell purity with <5% enterochromaffin cells, co-evaluated with adult beta-cell ectonucleotidase NTPDase3+/ENTPD3+ per Saunders et al. 2019 Cell Metab PMID:30449685 and CD9- negative selection per Li et al. 2020 PMID:33096048), alpha-like cells (CD26+/DPP4+ / CD49a-, excluding CD49a+ beta and polyhormonal cells, validated by intracellular GCG+ QC aliquot), and delta-like cells (validated by intracellular SST+ QC aliquot). Step 2 (60:30:10 Pre-Aggregation Input Seeding & Standardized 1,600-Cells/IEQ Volumetric Dosing): Using the unified conversion 1 IEQ (150 um sphere equivalent = 1.77x10^6 um^3) = 1,600 endocrine cells (matching 500,000 IEQ = 8.0x10^8 cells at curative scale), purified live endocrine subsets are seeded at a pre-aggregation input ratio of 1.2x10^6 beta : 6.0x10^5 alpha : 2.0x10^5 delta cells per 1,000 IEQ batch (2.0x10^6 total input cells before ~20% AggreWell re-aggregation/handling loss, yielding ~1.6x10^6 viable aggregated endocrine cells per 1,000 IEQ distributed across ~1,950 uniform <=120 um diameter spheroids of ~820 cells/spheroid) and dosed at 1,000 IEQ (1.6x10^6 cells) per assay well. A matched fixed/permeabilized destructive QC aliquot from each re-aggregated batch is stained intracellularly for NKX6-1+/C-peptide+/INS+ (BD clone R11-560), monohormonal GCG+/C-peptide-, SST+, and intracellular SLC18A1+ (VMAT1+) so exact viable beta-cell count per 1,000 IEQ is recorded as a continuous covariate alongside per-beta-cell normalized secondary readouts.

staged_protocol_clauses: 1. Dedicated post-washout conditioned-medium harvest from the materialised lead and a named matched parental or package-minus comparator under resting and one planned inflammatory condition, documenting viable input, conditioning time/volume, and maintained product PD-L1 state without reusing protease-challenge supernatant or antigen lysate.

2. Minimally processed cell-free effluent with a verified cell-free collection boundary and qualified clarification/filtration and matrix recovery for biologically relevant carrier forms so a fixed 0.45-um filter does not silently remove membrane/vesicle carriers.

3. One validated independently stimulated PD-1-responsive assay with stimulation/medium controls, matched control effluent, responder viability, active anti-PD-L1 blockade vs isotype (measured in blanks, control effluent, and lead effluent), and a form-relevant functional positive reference recovered through the actual processing train, reported as functional effects with uncertainty across independent preparations rather than inferred ng/mL PD-L1 equivalents.

4. Inflammatory cytokine carryover quantification and lot-matched cytokine-spiked unconditioned blanks (plus neutralisation or source/receiver controls where needed), reporting anti-PD-L1 rescue as PD-L1-pathway-dependent activity until receiver/accessory-cell PD-L1 induction and product-side source attribution are resolved.

5. Staged follow-up rule: a reproducible, source-attributed positive directs one decision-limiting follow-up (primary-human responder, carrier attribution, or extra-graft concentration-time bound); a sensitive controlled negative deprioritises further work within the tested product, state, processing method, and exposure bound; failed recovery, insensitive responder, carryover, or induction decay remains unresolved and triggers targeted calibration.

alias_structure.dealiasing_note: In the 16-run 2^(6-2)_IV screening block alone (Runs 01-16), the 22-column second-order model matrix has rank 14/22. Adding an unbridged 8-run block in a separate batch (Runs 01-24 with B) gives rank 22/22 genetic but 22/23 with the stage block, i.e. B is linearly dependent on the 2FIs, and every augmentation row has leverage 1. Therefore the 20-run Tier-2 block (Runs 17-36) includes 2 inter-stage bridge repeats of Tier-1 Runs 01 and 16 (Runs 25-26), duplicated Tier-2 de-aliasing runs (Runs 17-24 and 27-34) and 2 lead-chassis confirmatory replicates (Runs 35-36), achieving full rank 22/22 on genetic effects (max h_ii = 959/1112, trace = 22), full rank 23/23 with the stage-block column B (max h_ii = 175/202, trace = 23; projection residual SSR = 202/139), and 0 unit-leverage rows (leverage groups are listed in exact_rational_leverage_profile_with_stage_block_23cols).

quantitative_common_mode_failure_floor.formula: P_escape_total = q_common_mode + (1 - q_common_mode) * r_iid (bounded above by min(1, r_iid + q_common_mode))
quantitative_common_mode_failure_floor.scenario_assumption_status: Illustrative conditional engineering scenario assumptions (NOT empirically measured clinical failure frequencies). When endocrine-only r_iid = 1 - (1 - 10^-8)^(8e4) = 7.9968e-4, keeping P_escape_total = q + (1 - q)*r_iid <= 1.0e-3 requires q <= 2.005e-4; when pan-lineage r_iid = 1 - (1 - 10^-8)^(93,350) = 9.33064516e-4 (including 13,350 vascular iEC/iPericyte proliferating cells), keeping P_escape_total <= 1.0e-3 requires exact q <= (10^-3 - r_iid)/(1 - r_iid) = 0.000066998080 (~6.70e-5, where rounded-up 6.70e-5 gives P_escape_total = 0.0010000019 and linear union-bound subtraction gives 6.6935e-5; plating N_eff = -ln(0.05)/10^-8 = 299,573,227.36 effective cells at point-estimate eta = 0.334 requires 896,925,831 physical cells [or N_eff / eta_95_lower when propagating the Clopper-Pearson lower 95% confidence bound on the 50/150 spike-in recovery], whereas literal N_eff = 300,000,000 requires 898,203,593 physical cells, and if non-proliferating Stage-7 cells do not form colonies in the clonogenic assay then N_eff denominators count MACS-enriched proliferating/Ki67+ cells plated rather than bulk post-mitotic beta cells). Crucially, q_max = 6.70e-5 is a conditional preclinical risk-budget parameter (proving q_common <= q_max via non-parametric zero-failure batch testing 1 - 0.05^(1/n_batches) <= q_max would require ceil(ln(0.05)/ln(1 - 0.000066998080)) = 44,713 independent differentiation batches at exact unrounded q_max, or ceil(ln(0.05)/ln(1 - 6.70e-5)) = 44,711 batches at literal rounded 6.70e-5), and the Stage-0 5-aza-dC / BCL2L1 spike-in assay is a mechanistic positive-control challenge rather than an empirical prevalence bound on q_common (AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).
quantitative_common_mode_failure_floor.note: Even when i.i.d. per-cell escape is <=10^-8, shared batch-level promoter methylation, pre-differentiation clonal mutation, or avascular prodrug under-exposure creates a non-i.i.d. common-mode floor unless mitigated by unlinked dual-locus insertion and post-differentiation QC.

common_mode_silencing_and_en_bloc_surgic.per_graft_vs_per_cell_common_mode_distin: Layer-1 q_common_mode <= 6.6998e-5 is the per-graft/per-batch catastrophic failure probability in P_escape_total = q_common_mode + (1 - q_common_mode)*(1 - (1 - p_cell)^93350), which at q_common_mode = 6.6998e-5 matches the 10^-3 total dose-level ceiling when per-cell escape is at the two-independent-allele floor p_cell = p_ind^2 = 10^-8 (leaving remaining cell-level headroom p_cell <= 1.00000094e-8, i.e. p_common_cell <= 9.4e-16 when q_common_mode = 6.6998e-5 is simultaneously active, whereas under a pure cell-level budget q_common_mode = 0 the 10^-3 dose-level ceiling allows p_cell <= 1.0718e-8, i.e. per-cell p_common_cell <= 7.18e-10; DEC-078); if per-cell trans-epigenetic/XIAP resistance is p_common_cell in [10^-6, 10^-5] (Layer 2), expected surviving proliferating cells per 93,350-cell dose are E = [0.0943, 0.9344] and Poisson dose-level escape probability is P(>=1 survivor) = 1 - exp(-E) = [8.9975%, 60.7192%] (90x-607x above 10^-3; AUDIT-REF [DEC-046/DEC-078]).
common_mode_silencing_and_en_bloc_surgic.en_bloc_surgical_pouch_retrievability_ga: Positions iCasp9 + AP1903 as a high-depth pharmacological debulking switch (>= 4-5 log reduction, tested across N_eff >= 299,573,228 effective clonogenic trials with explicit k = 0 surviving colonies in Stage-0 Gate S9) paired with primary mechanical containment and en-bloc surgical retrievability of the dual pre-vascularized omental pouches (Gate 0S-Retrieval), so patient safety does not rely solely on extrapolated 10^-8 two-allele independence in the presence of cell-wide trans-acting epigenetic silencing or XIAP/BCL-xL apoptotic resistance (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-044/DEC-046]).

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Note on mechanism (Audit A05): Once suicide cassettes are biallelically integrated at both AAVS1 (PPP1R12C Chr19q13.42) alleles, ordinary homologous mitotic recombination or loss of a single 19q arm does NOT simultaneously eliminate both cassettes. Loss of both copies at a single locus instead requires either (a) LOH/arm loss acting on a subclone that originally received only a monoallelic integration, or (b) sequential second-hit focal deletion/frameshift/silencing of the remaining allele during master cell bank expansion.
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Verify 100% biallelic integration in single-cell-derived master cell bank clones by digital droplet PCR (ddPCR) + long-read sequencing across Chr19q13.42; if sequential two-hit escape exceeds 10^-8 in expanded MCBs, escalate to the K=5 dual-safe-harbor architecture adding a second unlinked cassette at GAPDH-P2A-iCasp9 (Chr12p13.31).

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Correlated de novo DNMT3A/3B methylation during 35-day Stage 0->7 differentiation can silence both copies of a viral CAG promoter at AAVS1 (Ordovas et al. 2015 PMID:26455413).
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Replace viral CAG with a 455 bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (function pending; published 0.7 kb CBX3-A2UCOE is a different element) + native human EEF1A1-core promoter (230 bp, 19 CpGs, 60.0% GC) flanked by cHS4 insulators (Muller-Kuller et al. 2015 PMID:25605798; Pfaff et al. 2013 PMID:23307570; Zhang et al. 2017 PMID:28860464) and require 60-day post-differentiation + inflammatory cytokine (IFN-g/TNF-a/IL-1b) challenge before AP1903 clonogenic escape testing (adjusting the zero-event upper 95% bound by empirical colony-forming plating efficiency).

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Because AP1903 chemically dimerizes iCasp9 in the cytosol, bypassing an upstream requirement for mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) to initiate procaspase-9 activation (though downstream caspase-3 feedback can still recruit mitochondrial amplification and Smac/DIABLO release; Yuan et al. 2022 PMID:35013114, Guerrero et al. 2012 PMID:23539542), upregulation of X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis protein (XIAP / BIRC4) in hypoxic or cytokine-stressed grafts can bind the exposed ATPF tetrapeptide of cleaved Caspase-9 via its BIR3 domain and arrest executioner Caspase-3/7 activation (Srinivasula et al. 2001 Nature PMID:11242052; Red-Team RT3-03).
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Test Decision Experiment #4 clonogenic escape under combined 1% O2 hypoxia + IFN-g/TNF-a/IL-1b (XIAP-high state) and evaluate the unvalidated preclinical salvage hypothesis of co-dosing AP1903 (2 x 0.4 mg/kg) with a SMAC mimetic / IAP antagonist (IV birinapant [PMC4742409] or oral xevinapant [noting Phase III TrilynX termination, doi:10.1200/JCO-25-00272]) to displace XIAP from iCasp9.

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Krogh oxygen diffusion (R <= 60 um < R_crit = 74.6 um conservative rat islet benchmark [149.2 um diameter at V_max = 0.0524 mol/m^3/s] and < R_crit = 92.6 um Stage 7 human SC-islet benchmark [185.2 um diameter at V_max = 0.034 mol/m^3/s]; Finding 056) prevents central anoxic necrosis but does not by itself prove uniform lipophilic AP1903 dimerizer pharmacokinetic penetration into fibrotic or poorly perfused in vivo graft pockets.
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Empirically validate 2-dose AP1903 (2 x 0.4 mg/kg, 48h apart) mass-spectrometry tissue penetration and >99.99% bioluminescent/histological graft clearance in vascularized in vivo sentinel grafts.

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Cas9 DSBs trigger p53-dependent arrest/apoptosis in 80-95% of wild-type hPSCs (Ihry et al. 2018 PMID:29892062; Haapaniemi et al. 2018 PMID:29892067), strongly selecting for pre-existing dominant-negative TP53 mutations (Merkle et al. 2017 PMID:28445466) and sub-karyotypic Chr20q11.21 (BCL2L1/BCL-xL) copy-number gains (Avery et al. 2013 PMID:24286026; Red-Team RT3-01).
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Execute K=4 editing as a 2-step sequential workflow (<=2 loci/step using orthogonal HiFi-SpCas9 + AsCas12a Ultra with transient i53/RAD51 mRNA HDR enhancement; Schiroli et al. 2019 PMID:30905619; in each step, N_effective = 2 chromosomal loci are cleaved simultaneously [1 heterotypic locus pair], corresponding to N_total = 4 diploid alleles [4 inter-chromosomal + 2 homologous allele pairs]; Finding 028) and enforce 3-timepoint longitudinal QC (Seed -> MCB -> Stage 7 EOPC): error-corrected duplex sequencing of TP53/PPM1D/BCOR (noting that 2,000x duplex depth yields only 1 - exp(-0.2) = 18.1% single-molecule sensitivity at VAF = 10^-4, whereas >=95% single-molecule sensitivity at VAF = 10^-4 requires >=29,956 independent duplex molecules [>=30,000x target-enriched duplex depth, and >=62,958 duplex molecules (~63,000x depth) for >=95% power to observe >=3 mutant duplex molecules, vs 87.5% power at 50,000x; Finding 082]), Chr20q11.21 (BCL2L1) ddPCR (CN = 2.00 +/- 0.15 [1.85, 2.15]), functional Nutlin-3a p53 transcriptional response (10 uM Nutlin-3a 8-h p21/CDKN1A and MDM2 mRNA fold induction >= 5.0x; obs_nutlin3a_p21_mdm2_fold_induction >= 5.0), 15-25 kb long-read ONT/PacBio + +/-50 kb flanking SNP LOH phasing (Kosicki et al. 2018 PMID:30010673), and CAST-Seq translocation assay (Turchiano et al. 2021 PMID:33626327).

antiviral_sanctuary_and_cell_intrinsic_v.lead_product_tyk2_wt_policy: All lead clinical candidates (Embodiment A* ISLET1_A4_ARM1B, Arm 1X ISLET1_A4_X_MOL_RNLS_WT, and composite challenger ISLET1_COMP_R4_X_BFB_DXB_LOWLOAD1500) retain wild-type TYK2 (TYK2-WT) to preserve full IFNAR1/2-STAT1/2 Type-I interferon and IL-12/IL-23 antiviral innate immunity; optional TYK2 P1104A (rs34536443) satellite variants are strictly quarantined from clinical promotion unless they clear Stage-0 Gate 0V.
antiviral_sanctuary_and_cell_intrinsic_v.stage0_gate_0v_live_viral_challenge_prot: Challenge engineered SC-islet organoids at MOI 0.01 and 0.1 with diabetogenic Coxsackievirus B1/B3/B4 (CVB1/CVB3/CVB4, CXADR-tropic), human cytomegalovirus (HCMV), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) for 28 days in the presence of NK cells and autologous/allogeneic PBMCs; require >= 3.0 log10 reduction in viral genome copies by Day 14 (obs_gate0v_cvb_day14_log10_viral_reduction >= 3.0), 0% persistent VP1+ or IE1+ reservoir cells at Day 28 (obs_gate0v_day28_persistent_vp1_ie1_positive_cell_pct <= 0.0%), intact cytosolic RNA-sensing MDA5 (IFIH1) / RIG-I (DDX58) / MAVS pathway activation, and bystander uninfected beta-cell GSIS SI >= 2.5.
antiviral_sanctuary_and_cell_intrinsic_v.cell_intrinsic_mda5_rigi_mavs_intactness: Verify intact cell-intrinsic MDA5 (IFIH1) / RIG-I (DDX58) / MAVS -> IRF3/IFN-beta/IFN-lambda1 induction upon poly(I:C) or CVB1/CVB4 challenge so enteroviral abortive clearance operates autonomously upstream of MHC-I/CD8+ CTLs.

cell_intrinsic_viral_fuse_challenger.mechanism: Cell-intrinsic viral-replication-triggered abortive suicide fuse (dsRNA-sensing PKR/OAS1-RNase L or IFIH1/MAVS-inducible caspase-9/GSDME circuit) that selectively aborts virally infected cells before virion assembly and paracrine spread without requiring MHC-I/CD8+ CTL recognition.

coupled_shield_switch_coinheritance_and_.co_inherited_locus1_surface_eraser_tag_c: Co-inheritance challenger coupling an antibody-depletable compact surface tag (RQR8 or tEGFR) or bicistronic CD47-P2A-iCasp9 / orthogonal second suicide switch directly into the Locus-1 B2M immune-shield bicistron so that promoter-level epigenetic silencing or whole-locus LOH obligately co-silences HLA-E/CD47 and exposes the cell to immediate innate NK/macrophage clearance, while independent AAVS1 iCasp9 is retained alongside because downstream coding frameshift or P2A ribosome skipping (~5-15% incomplete cleavage) does not abrogate upstream HLA-E/CD47 translation.
coupled_shield_switch_coinheritance_and_.dual_orthogonal_eraser_requirement: Require two mechanistically independent elimination modalities (AAVS1 iCasp9/AP1903 monotherapy + orthogonal cell-surface antibody-mediated CDC/ADCC or HSV-TK/ganciclovir backup), each independently achieving >= 4-log10 depletion under combined 1% O2 hypoxia + 20q11.21/BCL2L1 trisomy.
coupled_shield_switch_coinheritance_and_.post_stress_20q11_outgrowth_assay: Subject 10^8 differentiated Stage-7 cells to 72-h 1% O2 hypoxia + IFN-g/TNF-a/IL-1b + sub-lethal AP1903 cycling followed by 28-day outgrowth, requiring zero positive selection or clonal enrichment of 20q11.21/BCL2L1 copy number or TP53/PPM1D/BCOR variants (obs_post_stress_20q11_bcl2l1_outgrowth_fold <= 1.0 point estimate and upper95 <= 1.20x) and functional p53 Nutlin-3a response >= 5.0x (obs_nutlin3a_p21_mdm2_fold_induction >= 5.0).

wt_iapp_pouch_accumulation_and_pramlinti.pouch_iapp_mass_balance: 40 IU/day insulin (~240 nmol/day) co-secretes 2.4-12.0 nmol/day human WT IAPP (at 1-5% molar ratio); distributed into a 7.0 mL pouch volume with restricted macromolecular washout and matrix binding, local interstitial WT IAPP generation reaches 0.34-1.71 uM/day, crossing the micromolar nucleation threshold for toxic beta-sheet oligomerization and NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1beta activation (Westermark et al. 2008 PMID:18753660; Masters et al. 2010 PMID:20835230).
wt_iapp_pouch_accumulation_and_pramlinti.conditional_lead_promotion_rule: Stage-0 Gate 0E-amyloid runs a 7-to-14-day confined high-glucose (16.7 mM) + exogenous preformed WT human IAPP fibril-seeding challenge in the 350-um hydrogel coupon; if WT IAPP exhibits Thioflavin-T (ThT) amyloid area > 1.0% (> 2.0x baseline), A11 toxic oligomer positivity, macrophage NLRP3 IL-1beta release (> 50 pg/mL), or > 3-5% beta-cell caspase-3/apoptosis, non-amyloidogenic pramlintide-like IAPP(A25P/S28P/S29P) (product candidate ISLET1_A4_IAPP_PRAM / satellite coupon ER_IAPP_PRAMLINTIDE_RNLS_WT, K=0 DSBs, B=1 base edit) is promoted via sequential DSB-free base editing (or paired only with DSB-only K<=4 stacks so simultaneous base-editor burden remains B<=1 and avoids the GRAVEYARD_006 B>=2 WARN engineering-complexity discount rule; DEC-054/057/058).

nominal_allocation_illustration_4_blocks.note: Nominal allocation illustration assuming stated beta fractions are achieved before beta-only controls, assay allocation, and process losses; recalculate actual cell budget from measured composition and recovery. Not a power analysis.

bounded_intermediate_endocrine_mixture_c.scope_and_non_conflation_note: Supplements the 60:30:10 reference and fixed-beta / fixed-total beta-only boundary controls (ISLET-1-BLUEPRINT.md:244-246) with a bounded, staged intermediate-mixture comparison motivated by Perez-Frances et al. 2024 PMID:39169271 (human primary beta-cell pseudoislets in vitro GSIS/OCR in Figure 7 and adult-mouse in vivo regulation) and counter-balanced by Meng et al. 2025 PMID:40782792 (reconstructed endocrine-subtype-complete human PSC-islets). Changes neither the 60:30:10 reference recipe nor any existing dynamic-function gate (scripts/wetlab_contract.py:1855-1867) or release threshold.
staged_protocol_clauses: 1. Screen at fixed total input first: use blocked, randomised sibling preparations of R=60:30:10 and M1=70:20:10, M2=70:25:5, M3=80:15:5, M4=80:10:10 (M1/M2 lower-perturbation priorities if capacity-limited) with existing beta-only boundary controls; keep assigned recipe primary while directly measuring input-stream purity (up to 80% live beta enrichment in Veres et al. 2019 PMID:31068696 is an enrichment step, not measured purity or a universal ceiling), achieved composition, post-handling recovery, aggregate size/volume, and process losses.

2. Measure whole-preparation function and burden: under the same declared glucose/oxygen waveform, retain raw traces, incremental insulin/C-peptide output U, absolute low-glucose glucagon output G, basal secretion, stimulation/first-phase measures, both t50 and t90 shut-off, and identity/processing readouts (per preparation and per starting/surviving beta and alpha populations), alongside total tissue volume V, state-qualified oxygen consumption Q, and starting-cell/process burden H.

3. Select once; confirm independently: advance at most one candidate from the blocked screen on the measured functional/burden trade-off and confirm on new independent differentiation blocks at fixed viable-beta input and at a directly measured equal-output dose (verified on new preparations, not inferred from beta fraction, SI, or the selected screen), without multiplying mixture dose savings by unqualified folded-area credit.

4.
